structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The subtle change of viewpoint emphasizes how the timber divider creates distinct private and shared zones while keeping the small apartment visually open and spacious.
structured_intent.initial_state: The apartment is completely still, viewed across a central floor-to-ceiling timber divider with the bed on its left and the dining area on its right.
structured_intent.primary_action: The viewpoint shifts slightly to the right relative to the central timber divider while the entire interior remains motionless.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The viewpoint rests slightly farther to the right, revealing a small parallax change around the divider while the room and all its contents remain unchanged.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The central timber divider remains rigidly connected from floor to ceiling between the sleeping area and the dining area.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The apartment continues to read as a calm, open home with clearly separated functional zones.

prompt.positive: From rest, the stabilized camera glides very slowly a few centimeters to the right past the central timber divider, then decelerates softly to a complete stop near the end. Every curtain, fabric, architectural line, and piece of furniture remains perfectly still and unchanged.
